## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for users?

## Verification

Commands run and their results. For a plugin change, name the host/version and
distinguish unit tests from real-host verification.

## Release impact

Does this change a package version, installation step, configuration default,
or supported host? Update the affected manifests, guides, and release notes.

Keep images, videos, and large payloads outside Git; use external links.
